summary: scripts/st-test signs and checks the tree the CI gate will judge: the pushed head, or the merge of the head with the base when the gate would fall back to the merge tree (protected files moved on main since the branch point, or far behind). The rule is the base gate's own: choose_tree's history half is now the function branch_point_verdict, which st-test loads from the base. st-test --status (what the pre-push hook asks) judges the same tree.

replay.detail: st-test and the evidence gate's history rule only (local pre-sign script plus a pure refactor of scripts/ci-evidence-gate); the gate's decisions are unchanged.
